description: This file defines a utility function 'searchRdkProfile' that reads the device properties file to determine the device profile (TV or STB) based on the 'RDK_PROFILE' property. It includes macro definitions, an enum for profile types, and the function implementation.

methods.name: searchRdkProfile
methods.description: Reads the device properties file to find the 'RDK_PROFILE' property and returns the corresponding profile enum (TV or STB).
